_comment: Sample white-label client config. JSON does not allow // comments — keep this file strictly valid JSON or the loader silently falls back to default branding.

brand._comment: name: chat header display name | shortName: 1-2 char FAB fallback if no logo | primaryColor: hex for header/FAB/user bubbles | logoUrl: optional logo image URL
brand.name: YourPaper AI

contentSource._comment: type is one of: rss | api | pdf | scrape. For api set endpoint (+ apiKey if auth). For pdf set pdfUrl. For scrape set scrapeUrl (+ optional selectors: { headline, summary, section }).

_note: API keys belong in backend/.env (GEMINI_API_KEY, SARVAM_API_KEY). Never put real keys in this config file — it ships with the widget to the browser.
